title: Throughput safeguard controller and throttle orchestration for Dedicated fleets
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Dedicated customers need a predictable minimum throughput commitment even under transient overloads without sacrificing overall cluster efficiency. This PR introduces the Throughput Safeguard Controller (TSC) plus a throttle-orchestration layer that coordinates soft-throttles, capacity reclaims, and short-term headroom loans across fleet partitions. Design summary: TSC maintains per-tenant SLA windows (configurable percentiles and durations) and computes a minimal commit rate that must be enforced by request routers. Throttle-orchestration is an async coordinator that applies soft-throttles first, then issues temporary headroom loans from warm pools, and finally triggers proportional reclaimed tokens from low-util tenants when outages are imminent. Implementation notes: adds a new controller pkg/controller/safeguard with a reconciler loop, protobuf for the SafeguardPolicy CRD, scheduler hooks into pkg/routing to enforce policy tokens, new telemetry metrics (safeguard_committed_rps, safeguard_throttle_events_total, safeguard_loaned_tokens), and a fair reclaim algorithm implemented in pkg/fleet/reclaimer.go. Config knobs: policy.percentile, policy.window_seconds, policy.min_commit_rps, policy.max_loan_duration_ms, reclaim_threshold_percent. Migration: default policies are disabled; operators can enable per-tenant via Console or CLI. Rollout: feature-flag gated, will be enabled for 10% of Dedicated clusters for canary then ramp. Tests: unit tests for controller logic, integration tests that simulate overloads and assert commit guarantees, stress benchmark added to benchmark-lab harness. Related: Linear ENG-1980, ENG-2034. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Telemetry dashboards added - [x] Docs and Console knobs - [x] Feature flag gating - [x] Manual canary plan

release_notes: Adds "Throughput Safeguard Controller" to enforce minimal per-tenant throughput guarantees on Dedicated fleets. New CRD: SafeguardPolicy, telemetry metrics, and console controls. Feature gated and disabled by default; operators must opt-in. Improves availability under transient overloads by combining soft-throttles, loaning warm pool headroom, and proportional token reclamation from low-util tenants.
